```{r}
library(reactable)
source("scripts/shared.R")

# Agenda PDFs are named <committee>_<MM>_<DD>_<YY>.pdf, e.g. anr_10_17_25.pdf
pdf_files <- list.files(AGENDAS_DIR, pattern = "\\.pdf$")

if (length(pdf_files) == 0) {
  cat("Committee agendas have not been set.")
} else {
  agendas <- data.frame(filename = pdf_files) |>
    mutate(
      code  = str_extract(filename, "^[^_]+"),
      month = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_)\\d{2}(?=_\\d{2}_\\d{2})"),
      day   = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_\\d{2}_)\\d{2}(?=_\\d{2})"),
      year  = str_extract(filename, "(?<=_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_)\\d{2}"),
      Date = as.Date(paste0("20", year, "-", month, "-", day)),
      Committee = unname(COMMITTEE_NAMES[code])
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(Date))

  legsim_table(
    agendas |> select(Date, Committee),
    searchable = FALSE,
    page_size = 20,
    columns = list(
      Date = colDef(name = "Meeting Date", format = LEGSIM_DATE, width = 130),
      Committee = colDef(name = "Committee",
        cell = link_cell("", file.path(AGENDAS_DIR, agendas$filename)))
    )
  )
}
```
